event.description: Welcome! We're so excited to celebrate with you. We've created this website to share details about our wedding and help you make the most of the weekend. We can't wait to spend this special day with our favorite people.

faqs.question: What should I wear?
faqs.answer: Estate Garden Attire: polished, comfortable attire appropriate for an outdoor celebration. Dresses, jumpsuits, dress shirts, slacks, suits, and dressy aloha wear are all welcome. Since the ceremony and reception take place outdoors on grass, we recommend choosing footwear accordingly.

faqs.question: How do I get to the venue?
faqs.answer: Parking is not available at Kaimea Estates. Complimentary shuttle service will be provided to and from the venue. Shuttles depart from: Kahala Mall, Mānoa Marketplace, and Ala Moana Shopping Center. Please arrive at your shuttle location by 2:30 PM. We recommend using Uber, Lyft, taxi, or a designated driver to reach the shuttle locations.

faqs.question: Can I bring a plus-one?
faqs.answer: If your invitation includes a plus-one, your guest is welcome to attend. Due to venue capacity limitations, we are unfortunately unable to accommodate additional guests beyond those listed on the invitation.

faqs.question: Are children invited?
faqs.answer: We kindly encourage guests to arrange childcare if possible. However, if you plan to bring your child, please let us know as soon as possible due to our strict guest capacity.

faqs.question: What time should I arrive?
faqs.answer: Please plan to arrive at your designated shuttle pickup location by 2:30 PM on October 16th. Shuttle schedules and detailed pickup instructions will be provided closer to the wedding date.

faqs.question: Will the ceremony and reception be outdoors?
faqs.answer: Yes, the ceremony will take place entirely outdoors. The majority of the reception will also be outdoors, with covered dining areas available. Please plan for an outdoor celebration.

faqs.question: What's the weather like in October?
faqs.answer: October is typically warm and pleasant, with daytime temperatures ranging from the mid-70s to mid-80s. While sunshine is common, brief rain showers are always a possibility. We recommend dressing comfortably and being prepared for a little bit of everything!

faqs.question: Is there an open bar?
faqs.answer: Yes! An open bar will be available throughout the evening, featuring beer, wine, cocktails, and our signature drinks.

faqs.question: What kind of food will be served?
faqs.answer: Rather than a traditional seated dinner, we're offering a relaxed dining experience with a variety of small plates and shared bites throughout the evening. Guests can sample, mingle, and enjoy the celebration at their own pace.

faqs.question: Will there be dancing?
faqs.answer: We'll be sharing a few special dances, but don't expect a packed dance floor! We're designed this celebration to be more about spending quality time with the people we love. Expect lawn games, comfortable lounge spaces, and plenty of opportunities to mingle.
